title: Eternal Youth
description: The Eternal Youth is a consumable item that - quite simply put - imbues the animal it's used on with a never ending state of immortality as a youngling. If the animal in question is not currently young, it will be reverted to its youth. The immortality given is near absolute; the few ways of killing such an animal is either to lose it to the void or to use a second Eternal Youth on them.
